outcomes.FNRI15_INSEC: FNRI 2015 FSS: not food secure (100 - food secure), % (derived complement)
outcomes.ENNS_SEV: ENNS severe food insecurity, % (secondary: DEPDev RDP matrix; one year per province)
outcomes.ENNS_MODSEV: ENNS moderate-to-severe food insecurity, % (secondary; one year per province)
outcomes.PSA_SUB_FAM: PSA subsistence incidence among families, % (food poverty)
outcomes.PSA_SUB_POP: PSA subsistence incidence among population, % (food poverty)

protocol.matching: mean of out-of-sample quarterly scores with target quarter in the reference year, per lead 1-4; issue before target quarter; ENNS matched province by province to its own reference year
protocol.availability_rule: a survey value is usable from 1 January of reference year + 2 (conservative)
protocol.rank_metrics: Spearman (average ranks) with exact one-sided permutation p over 120 orders; pooled = mean within-year rho, exact p by convolution; top-1 hit; top-2 overlap
baselines_rank: prior wave of the same PSA indicator
latest provincial poverty incidence available by 1 Jan of the reference year
FNRI 2015 severe food insecurity (for reference years >= 2017)

level_candidates.L1: CALABARZON prior-wave value for every province
level_candidates.L2: mean of the province's prior waves
level_candidates.L3: prior wave shrunk to the regional prior wave by w = tau2/(tau2+se2), tau2 = max(0, var(prior) - mean(se2))
level_candidates.L4: ridge alpha=1 on standardized [prior subsistence, prior poverty, FI10 Lead-2 mean price-pressure p] trained on the 2018->2021 transition; 2023 only

protocol.classification: HIGH only if province > CALABARZON with |z| > 1.96 (z uses both SEs); classification metrics only if at least 3 HIGH and 3 LOW exist

decision.rank_skill: exact p < 0.05 and rho above the best baseline on the same observations
decision.level_skill: MAE below L0 and L1 in every test wave
decision.lead_reliable_provincial_fi: rank skill on a track-A outcome in at least two independent reference years
